notes.title: 1.24.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

This one is more of a bug fix / maintenance update; no noticeable content changes besides for some UI tweaks. I'm not active on social media (anxiety) these days so I tend to use these update notes as a chance to touch base with you guys. If you want to skip my tedtalk, feel free to jump to the bottom for patch notes.

I saw a comment the other day that made me laugh. It was something like "did the devs take the money and run?" I can see where they were coming from and, honestly, I agree - the devs are flaky af. I drop the ball a lot and I don't have an excuse.  Sorry the game sometimes breaks, sorry we sometimes just ghost, and sorry we sometimes drop an update unannounced. Not an excuse but maybe I can share some of the behind-the-scenes that'll explain part of our shortcomings. 

The OG bus gang knows this but for the newer bus drivers: the Stovetop team is 2 devs that aren't even full time (yet). I have a corporate 9 to 5 which means my game dev time is limited to after work. The other dev is doing something similar, balancing heavy grad school course work & game dev. IRL pulls us away a lot but we keep coming back because this is obviously where our passion is. In fact, recently we've been prototyping game 2 but took a break to revisit the bus game. Just wanted to say that yes, we're still invested and cooking. It was never about the money so the tradeoff is that we get to keep promises like this: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34375765/b0ddae272f3309e789383d19149609b846443f5b.png

Grateful for you guys and thanks for checking us out :)

- Frank

This patch was largely to clean up things internally to allow for future updates, boring things like: updating game engine, refactoring code, doing prep work for localization, etc.
Here are some minor changes:

notes.title: v1.21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Notes
Hi all, long time no chat. Thanks for being patient with this one. In this next update, the team continued to experiment with multiplayer gameplay. 

Most Snakeybus maps are flat and allow players to B-line from drop-off to drop-off. The flat map style works in single player where the driving experience is more lax but quickly becomes problematic in multiplayer. Coupled with the fact that there is only one drop-off active at a time, players are quickly exhausted from cross-map sprints. Our next map, Tower City, focuses on verticality which moves drop-offs to different height levels preventing a straight shot from each drop-off. 

[previewyoutube=NVq487C9Me4;full][/previewyoutube]

The team also noticed that players can experience bus-constipation where player 1 is hitting all the drop-offs so player 2 is stuck with a bus full of passengers. To address this, we've turned on concurrent drop-offs in multiplayer. In the voice of DJ Khaled: another one.

Because of the added verticality, Tower City is less about "keep moving / don't run into yourself" and more about map knowledge and finding opportune times to use power ups. We tried play testing in single player but found that with the additional verticality, it was impossible to "die." For this reason, Tower city will be multiplayer exclusive - apologize in advance to the single players.

There is also an effort to balance power ups, mainly the shovel-ramp and missile. The shovel has been adjusted to cut up to 50 segments. So if your opponent has 50 segments, and you cut them at the middle, they would lose only 25 segments. Track down the head bus and cut subsequent segments for maximum effectiveness.

The missile impact has changed from OP nuke to a blast radius effect. Aim towards clustered areas of segments for max effectiveness.

Good luck.

Updates

New

 New Map: Tower City
 New Game Modes
    - First To (first to X segments)
    - Pacifist (longest bus when game clock ends, no weapons)
 Multiplayer Lobby UI Refresh
 Multiple respawn points in multiplayer
 "Self Healing" bus (see gif)


Adjustments

 Shovel power up
    - Now on a timer. After using the power up, players have 10 seconds to ram into another bus. before the shovel retracts automatically.
    - Before: sever all remaining segments. Now: sever up to 50 segments

 Missile Launcher
    - Before: sever all remaining segments. Now: sever segments within the explosive radius.
 Concurrent Drop Offs
    - Prevent bus constipation and lopsided snow balling.
    - Bus Arrow and Drop Off UI indicates nearest drop off


Fixes

 Before: able to to shoot missile before it was out. After: must wait for missile launcher's animation to shoot.


Discord for community feedback / bugs / play testing
Twitter to say hi or watch me post gifs

notes.title: Multiplayer Update IS HERE!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This has been probably our biggest feature request since Day 1. I'm excited to announce that our multiplayer is live today!

Battle and race other bus drivers, longest bus wins. The multiplayer game mode introduces 3 power ups: infinite boosting, plow, and rockets. Utilize each to destroy and sever the opponent's segments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34375765/430d10962284f91466682edcaed32c813978370f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34375765/e4e6db8d3a55d0017f0c9ba15f693dab6562292d.gif

Our hope is that this update will give everyone a better idea as to what Snakeybus Multiplayer could be. The devs will continue to brainstorm and see what interesting dynamics can be added to the game. And of course we look forward to your suggestions.

See you guys online!

Thanks

notes.title: Update v1.6.1 - Jump Is Back!
notes.notes:
The jump ability originally was the occasional "get out of jail free" card to help players get unstuck. It has since evolved into a core mechanic that helps shape the hectic style of the game.

Thanks to popular demand and community feedback, we brought it back!

notes.title: Update v1.6
notes.notes:
Rework Jump / Boost
Previously, the player had abilities to "jump" and to "boost." Each ability held their separate cooldowns. This system wasn't intuitive and was difficult to control. The "jump" has been taken out and boosting is more controllable. The boost meter recharges over time or refills after picking up passengers. It is meant to be a get-out-of-jail-card.


New Menu
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/3547667672c01f328662614324cd0029faa0f0d1.png

Rework Player Progression
Players will continue to accrue points after each game. However, players no longer spend their credits to unlock buses / maps. Instead, content is unlocked based on their total accrued points. 

 Ex: Paris is automatically unlocked when you have a total of 4,000 points.

This replaces the previous, somewhat frustrating "play count" system. Points are earned based on performance, such as bus length, play time, and speed. Players will keep their progress if they unlocked content prior to this update.


New Map: Seattle
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/a03383feac5233d0d502b5aa7fcd1bd1d5c9d07d.png

New Map: Intersect
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/2d3f5a30cdbf322f768fac42b79e2046a29ab876.png

* These maps are both BETA, meaning they're not in a definitive state. We plan on taking feedback and further polishing the map. Leaderboards are turned off while in BETA.

Game Mode: Time Race (BETA)
Players race against the clock to drop off passengers. Successfully dropping off passengers will add time to the clock. Game ends when clock reaches zero. 

This game mode is labeled BETA - it's ready for players but is not in a definitive state. We plan on taking feedback and further polishing the game play. Leaderboards turned off while in BETA.

Music Expansion
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/46f02884469ba90effa0e1703324a7149df79d0b.png

Added FPS Limiter in Settings

notes.title: Dev Progress Update - 06/24/2019
notes.notes:
Hi all, here's a follow up to our previous announcement.

We have content that is work-in-progress but got delayed. Instead of releasing a big update, we will release rolling updates as features are completed. 

Here's the current state of each feature and our plans to release them:

Menu Rework
The new menu is to help streamline game options. Of course, we kept the most important feature:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/04af119c0e2de7b2d96bd3eab56b43daa68133c9.gif

Game Mode: Time Race (BETA) 
Players race against the clock to drop off passengers. Successfully dropping off passengers will add time to the clock. Game ends when clock reaches zero. 

This game mode is labeled BETA - it's ready for players but is not in a definitive state. We plan on taking feedback and further polishing the game play.

Map: Abstract 2
For those that have enjoyed the other abstract maps:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/c274817a6176f9dd9d944a95dc56f87c1015d26f.png

Map: Seattle (BETA)
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/4a07816c99689483e14d42a33efb5b500a21107c.png
This map is labeled BETA - it's ready for players but is not in a definitive state. We plan on taking feedback and further polishing the map.


Music Update
We are excited to introduce 7 new tracks! Details and links will be in the patch notes.

Everything listed above will be grouped into the next update, which will happen this week.

----------------------------------------------------------------------

Map: Cave and Game Mode: Aerial
This cave map is designed for an Aerial Game Mode. In Aerial, the player must stay in the air. While the player picks up passengers airborne, the water level in the cave rises. Touching the water ends the game. However, dropping off passengers will help drain the water level.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34375765/dc89cc7b2ceec26c94363b1130c4d777350bf313.png

A Snakeybus take on Flappy Bird.

We are currently doing internal play testing. We hope to release the BETA version soon.

The following tasks will be added as rolling updates. Content will be released independently (not grouped together) as soon as they are ready:

 Take player feedback and polish Seattle
 Take player feedback and polish Time Race
 Add leaderboards for Game Modes
 Release Cave Map and Aerial Game Mode (BETA)
 Take player feedback and polish Cave + Aerial
 Add Corgis. Sorry for the delay!
